notes.title: Brutal Orchestra is coming December 17th!
notes.notes:
The end is nigh!

December 17th take a journey into the depths of Purgatory, a place where all dead things one day come to rest.

[previewyoutube=NlP72KW_5rw;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1734320/Brutal_Orchestra

notes.title: VSync and more frame rate options
notes.notes: Added an option to disable or enable vertical synchronization on the settings. Also added a slider to change the frame rate between 40, 60, 72 or no limit!

notes.title: The short and somewhat disturbing Swallow the Sea is now on Steam
notes.notes:
Short on time and want to play a game? Swallow the Sea is a good choice and it's free so you've got nothing to lose for trying to except perhaps a little of your sanity.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/09/the-short-and-somewhat-disturbing-swallow-the-sea-is-now-on-steam

notes.title: Brutal Orchestra Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Today is a very big day for us!

[h1][b]Brutal Orchestra[/b] a new game from the artist and designer that brought you Perfect Vermin
[/h1]

[previewyoutube=0P4h23qz1-E;full][previewyoutube=0P4h23qz1-E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
[/previewyoutube]

Brutal Orchestra is a Turn-Based Roguelike Strategy game with resource management and deck-building elements. Employ the help of damaged and daring fools, equip ancient and insidious items and make deals with the devil on your path to revenge

We will have much more to share about Brutal Orchestra in the coming weeks. If you want to get a sneak peak early we know have an [url=https://discord.gg/b6Gm7ctKcX]official discord server[/url] for Brutal Orchestra and all the other games I have worked on: https://discord.gg/b6Gm7ctKcX

Keep an eye out we have so much more to share very very soon.
